short_zones.label: Value Area Low to POC resistance rejection

no_trade_conditions: Do not short before price reaches the upper liquidity and resistance zone.
Avoid trading if BTC reclaims and holds above 68000 with impulsive structure.
Stand aside if price action is choppy inside the range without a rejection signal.
Do not use the setup if price moves directly to downside targets without first sweeping upper liquidity.
notes: Transcript favors waiting for a wave 4 bounce into 65500-68000 resistance and upper liquidation clusters before looking for shorts toward 62500, 60000 and 59000. A sustained reclaim of 68000 weakens the setup; 74000 materially damages the wave 4 thesis.
